name: fallback-chain-01
title: Fallback Chain
description: Model fallback branches, live attempt status, latency, cost and response details.

files.content:
import type { FallbackChainLabels } from "./fallback-chain-types";
export const fallbackChainEnglishLabels: FallbackChainLabels = {
    request: "Request",
    response: "Response",
    responseWaiting: "Waiting…",
    waiting: "Waiting",
    trying: "Trying…",
    failed: "Failed",
    answered: "Answered",
    skipped: "Not needed",
    exhausted: "All attempts failed",
    noAttempts: "No models in this route",
    upNext: "Up next",
    retry: "Retry",
    models: "Models, in fallback order",
    model: "Model",
    time: "Time",
    cost: "Cost",
    attempts: "Attempts",
    totalTime: "Total time",
    totalCost: "Total cost",
    output: "Output",
    why: "Why",
    attempt: (current, total) => `Attempt ${current} of ${total}`,
    attemptCount: (current, total) => `${current} of ${total}`,
    tokens: (count) => `${count} tokens`,
    fromModel: (model) => `from ${model}`,
    duration: (value, unit) => `${value}${unit}`,
    timeBudget: (elapsed, limit) => elapsed === undefined ? `up to ${limit}` : `${elapsed} of ${limit}`,
};
export const fallbackChainChineseLabels: FallbackChainLabels = {
    request: "请求",
    response: "响应",
    responseWaiting: "等待响应…",
    waiting: "等待中",
    trying: "尝试中…",
    failed: "失败",
    answered: "已响应",
    skipped: "无需尝试",
    exhausted: "所有尝试均未成功",
    noAttempts: "此路由暂无模型",
    upNext: "即将尝试",
    retry: "重试",
    models: "按回退顺序排列的模型",
    model: "模型",
    time: "耗时",
    cost: "费用",
    attempts: "尝试次数",
    totalTime: "总耗时",
    totalCost: "总费用",
    output: "输出",
    why: "原因",
    attempt: (current, total) => `第 ${current} / ${total} 次尝试`,
    attemptCount: (current, total) => `${current} / ${total}`,
    tokens: (count) => `${count} Token`,
    fromModel: (model) => `来自 ${model}`,
    duration: (value, unit) => `${value} ${unit === "ms" ? "毫秒" : "秒"}`,
    timeBudget: (elapsed, limit) => elapsed === undefined ? `最多 ${limit}` : `${elapsed} / ${limit}`,
};
